summary: Iteration 3 - Full backend + frontend testing for the new-feature batch (landing page + auth redirect + ambassador CRUD + session past-date guardrail + track-locked catalog + session reminder banner + exams page + Google-btn removal). 11/11 new pytest cases pass. Frontend flows verified end-to-end at both desktop (1920) and mobile (390) viewports: new landing shown to guests with all CTAs and no Google button, register redirects to /ar/student, admin login redirects to /ar/admin, logged-in visitor at /ar auto-redirects to role dashboard, /ar/exams tabs work, sidebar-nav-exams present, admin session past-date shows inline error 'لا يمكن جدولة حصة في تاريخ ماضٍ' with datetime min attr enforced, admin ambassador add form creates ambassador + shows credentials banner + delete-ambassador-{id} works, session reminder banner appears for a student registered to a session <60min away with dismiss button, mobile has no horizontal overflow on landing/exams/dawarat.

minor.issue: Comma-joined Set-Cookie header (carried from iteration_2, still present) - non-blocking; browsers + curl clear correctly.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: iteration_1 test_dz_prime.py is stale (still assumes anon POST allowed for /api/sessions & /api/teachers, which are now role-gated). Recommend deleting it or rewriting authenticated fixtures.
Optional: emit two separate Set-Cookie headers in /api/auth/logout (iteration_2 minor issue, still present).
critical_code_review_comments: AmbassadorsTab.tsx does not confirm() before delete - a single click permanently removes an ambassador. Recommend adding a confirmation prompt (or an inline undo toast) to avoid accidental destructive actions from admin panel.

Ambassador form on client only exposes 4 inputs + wilaya select but the DELETE cascade route also drops the User.role back to STUDENT_FREE (soft-remove). Since the user record is retained, adding an ambassador with the same email twice will violate email uniqueness - the UI should either check for existing user or show a graceful error (currently the fetch will silently fail).

SessionsTab min={minDateTime} guard is client-side only; server (route.ts) also validates - good defense in depth. Consider surfacing server-returned Arabic error to teacher/admin form even when JS min guard was bypassed (currently already handled via addSession returning {success,error} - verified working).
